target_value: fever 39.2C with rigors, now hypotensive and tachycardic, severe worsening breast pain with overlying redness
label: severity escalated to acute

edits.find: persistent breast pain, and on examination there is still a fluctuant mass suggesting a non-resolving abscess.

rationale: Escalates the same non-resolving breast abscess toward systemic sepsis (rigors, hypotension, tachycardia, spreading cellulitis, severe worsening pain), which should move management toward urgent drainage/admission and broadened coverage.
